name: Old Fashioned
instructions: Mix whiskey, bitters, and sugar in a glass. Garnish with orange peel.

name: Margarita
instructions: Mix tequila, lime juice, and triple sec in a glass. Rim with salt.

name: Cosmopolitan
instructions: Mix vodka, triple sec, cranberry juice, and lime juice in a glass. Garnish with lime wheel.

name: Gin and Tonic
instructions: Mix gin and tonic water in a glass. Garnish with lime.

name: Mojito
instructions: Mix rum, lime juice, and mint leaves in a glass. Top with soda water.

name: Pina Colada
instructions: Mix rum, pineapple juice, and coconut cream in a glass. Garnish with pineapple wedge and cherry.

name: Whiskey Sour
instructions: Mix whiskey, lemon juice, and simple syrup in a glass. Garnish with lemon wheel.

name: Caipirinha
instructions: Muddle lime wedges and sugar in a glass. Add cachaça and stir.

name: Dark 'N' Stormy
instructions: Mix rum, ginger beer, and lime juice in a glass. Garnish with lime wedge.

name: Sidecar
instructions: Mix cognac, Cointreau, and lemon juice in a glass. Garnish with lemon wheel.

name: Moscow Mule
instructions: Mix vodka, ginger beer, and lime juice in a copper mug. Garnish with lime wedge and mint sprig.

name: Daiquiri
instructions: Mix rum, lime juice, and simple syrup in a glass. Garnish with lime wheel.

name: Sazerac
instructions: Mix whiskey, absinthe, bitters, and sugar in a glass. Garnish with lemon twist.

name: Pimm's Cup
instructions: Mix Pimm's No. 1 and lemonade in a glass. Garnish with cucumber and mint.

name: Espresso Martini
instructions: Mix vodka, espresso, Kahlúa, and sugar in a glass. Garnish with coffee beans.

name: French 75
instructions: Mix gin, lemon juice, and sugar in a glass. Top with champagne. Garnish with lemon twist.

name: Mai Tai
instructions: Mix rum, orange curaçao, lime juice, and orgeat syrup in a glass. Garnish with mint sprig and cherry.

name: Negroni
instructions: Mix gin, Campari, and sweet vermouth in a glass. Garnish with orange twist.

name: Cuba Libre
instructions: Mix rum and Coca-Cola in a glass. Squeeze in lime juice. Garnish with lime wedge.

name: Bee's Knees
instructions: Mix gin, honey syrup, and lemon juice in a glass. Garnish with lemon wheel.
